segments.text:
Lastly, I would leave a few words of support and comfort to such as sincerely study and endeavour according to the tendency of their new nature, to follow Christs example, but being weak in grace, and meeting with strong temptations, are frequently carried beside the holy purposes and designs of their honest meaning hearts, to the great grief and discouragement of their souls. They heartily wish and aim at holiness, and say with David, Psal. 119. 5. O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes. They follow after exactness in holiness as Paul did, Phil. 3. 12. If by any means they might attain it. But finding how short they come in all things of the rule and
pattern, they mourn as he did, Rom. 7. 24. O wretched ma•… that I am, who shall deliver me from the body of this death? Well, well, if this be thy case, be not discouraged, but hearken to a few words of support and comfort, with which I shall close this point.
